voice.welcome: Welcome to the Weather Observatory! Tap play and watch the meadow change.
voice.sun-prompt: First, tap the sun to warm the meadow.
voice.sun-result: Sunlight warms the earth. Look—the little bud is waking up!
voice.rain-prompt: Now tap rain to give the flower a drink.
voice.rain-result: Rain soaks into the soil. The flower is growing!
voice.wind-prompt: Slide the wind dial and help the leaves dance.
voice.wind-result: Whoosh! Wind pushes clouds and carries leaves through the sky.
voice.cloud-prompt: Tap the cloud to make cool shade.
voice.cloud-result: Clouds cover some sunlight and make a patch of shade.
voice.wind-nudge: Slide the golden dial toward the dancing leaves.
voice.complete: You did it! Sun, rain, wind, and clouds all change the meadow. You’re a Weather Scientist!
voice.free-lab: Now make your own weather. What happens when two kinds of weather meet?
voice.rainbow: Sun and rain together made a rainbow!
voice.reset: The observatory is ready for another weather day.
